estatutos.title: Who we are
estatutos.subtitle: We are the Latin American Society of Hip Surgery, a scientific network aimed at strengthening the surgical, academic, and ethical practice of our specialty throughout the region.
estatutos.mission_text: To gather and represent hip surgery specialists from all over Latin America, promoting academic, scientific, and ethical excellence in the treatment of hip pathologies. We are dedicated to driving knowledge exchange, disseminating new surgical techniques, and coordinating, supervising, and guaranteeing the highest quality in the training of new generations of specialists, working in close synergy with the national societies of each country.
estatutos.vision_text: To be the benchmark scientific institution and the governing body of hip surgery in Latin America. We aim to consolidate an integrated network of specialists that consistently raises quality standards in patient care, leading surgical innovation, scientific research, and the certification of continuous medical education programs continent-wide.
estatutos.values_subtitle: These principles guide every institutional action, every academic instance, and every scientific decision we promote at SLACC.

values.title: Academic and surgical excellence
values.description: We promote the standardization and constant updating of the most advanced and safe surgical techniques for the benefit of our patients.

values.title: Regional integration
values.description: We believe in the strength of unity. We foster collaborative work and cultural and scientific exchange among the hip societies of all Latin American countries.

values.title: Teaching commitment
values.description: We assume the responsibility of guiding, facilitating, and endorsing the training of new surgeons through structured programs, internships, and specialization scholarships.

values.title: Professional ethics
values.description: We guide all our actions and research under the strictest principles of integrity, transparency, and scientific rigor.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: We support and disseminate scientific research and the development of new technologies applied to hip orthopedics and traumatology.
